coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 1 of 5 ground-truth variable items (20%) at the conceptual level: the independent variable compares ground-truth, subsampled, and MDGEN-upsampled trajectories. The specified constants and dependent-variable definitions are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits pooling 30k test-peptide frames, fixed training crops up to 256 residues, every-40-frame training subsampling, and full-protein inference. Replaces the prescribed 100 fs reference and 10 ps coarse sampling with placeholders and a stride sweep. Uses normalized angular covariance instead of the cosine-difference autocorrelation over 100 fs–100 ps, and omits dynamic content defined as the negative derivative with respect to log-timescale.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion about recovery of sub-ps oscillations, agreement with ground-truth autocorrelation, or non-monotonic dynamic content, nor the absence of these features in subsampled trajectories.
